dialogues.speaker: Amauta's Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Our shop handles custom orders for all types of extreme sports gear as well as souvenir clothing for tourists!"

dialogues.speaker: Amauta's Advertisement
dialogues.text: "In addition to fine ores supplied by the Children of Echoes and fabrics chosen by the Collective of Plenty, we also use various raw materials imported from abroad."

dialogues.speaker: Amauta's Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Prices are negotiable, however big the order~"

dialogues.speaker: Advertisement Addendum
dialogues.text: "Important note: When ordering custom grappling hooks, please provide accurate body weight measurements. No shame in a few extra pounds — as long as a Yumkasaur can still lift you, you're good!"

dialogues.speaker: Advertisement Addendum
dialogues.text: "Accurate weight measurements are crucial for grappling hook safety!"
